_doc: The Frostspine (world-src/mountains), generated by a script from docs/concepts/mountains.webp. Phases: base fBm -> noise -> raise -> flatten (file order) -> paths -> carve -> water -> seams/border. A broad uplift (uplift_north) and the west_wall raise lift the ground from ~40 m at the Maple Terraces seam to ~200 m along the north and west edges, which are the world wall (border cliff, crags noise, mtn_peak landmarks on top). The main trail (frost_trail) enters from trail_mountains at (300, 1536), crosses the Lowpine Meadow (322, 1700) to Tarnhollow, an alpine valley at 55 m with the Tarn pool at (466, 1942); the Veilfalls track (veil_track) joins it there from the east seam at (768, 1646), where the Veilfalls' west_descent ends. From the trailhead (356, 2002) the Switchback Stair climbs ~55 m in four legs (three step flights at 1:2 under mtn_steps) to the Eyrie Shelf (324, 2246). The Rimecleft gorge (carve rimecleft) runs south from the shelf's north-east into Tarnhollow; the rope bridge spans it at z 2250 (x 384..424) to the Old Watch promontory (472, 2256), where the watchtower ruin stands at (470, 2262), door west. On foot the rim_loop goes round the gorge head (saddle at 426, 2420) to the tower. Trail surfaces are chains of flatten circles at the designed heights (<trail>_<n>, later ones win, so they read as smooth ramps).
